tasks.title: The Defining Feature of Mammals: Feeding the Young
paras: All mammals feed their young. Beluga whale mothers, for example, nurse their calves for some twenty months, until they are about to give birth again and their young are able to find their own food. The behavior of feeding the young is built into the reproductive system. It is a nonelective part of parental care and the defining feature of a mammal, the most important thing that mammals—whether marsupials, platypuses, spiny anteaters, or placental mammals —have in common.

But not all animal parents, even those that tend their offspring to the point of hatching or birth, feed their young. Most egg-guarding fish do not, for the simple reason that their young are so much smaller than the parents and eat food that is also much smaller than the food eaten by adults. In reptiles, the crocodile mother protects her young after they have hatched and takes them down to the water, where they will find food, but she does not actually feed them. Few insects feed their young after hatching, but some make other arrangement, provisioning their cells and nests with caterpillars and spiders that they have paralyzed with their venom and stored in a state of suspended animation so that their larvae might have a supply of fresh food when they hatch.

questions.stem: What does the passage mainly discuss?

options.A: The care that various animals give to their offspring.
options.B: The difficulties young animals face in obtaining food.
options.C: The methods that mammals use to nurse their young.
options.D: The importance among young mammals of becoming independent.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文分析：文章开篇描述了哺乳动物通过哺乳喂养幼崽的行为，强调这是哺乳动物的共同特征（“the defining feature of a mammal”）。随后，文章对比了其他动物（如鱼类、爬行动物和昆虫）在照顾幼崽时的行为，指出它们通常不直接喂养幼崽，而是通过其他方式（如保护或提供食物储备）来支持后代。这表明文章的核心主题是探讨不同动物对后代的照顾方式，A选项准确概括了这一内容。 选项分析： B选项，文章中并未重点讨论幼年动物获取食物的困难。 C选项，虽然文章提到哺乳动物通过哺乳喂养幼崽，并以白鲸为例，但这只是文章的一部分内容。文章不仅限于讨论哺乳动物的喂养方法，还广泛比较了其他动物。 D选项，文章提到白鲸幼崽在约20个月后能够自己寻找食物，但这仅是描述哺乳动物喂养行为的一部分，并未强调幼年哺乳动物独立的重要性。

questions.stem: The author mentions “marsupials, platypuses, spiny anteaters, or placental mammals” in order to

options.A: contrast the feeding habits of different types of mammals
options.B: describe the process by which mammals came to be defined
options.C: emphasize the point that every type of mammal feeds its own young
options.D: explain why a particular feature of mammals is nonelective

questions.analysis: 题型：修辞目的题 原文分析：文章中提到“marsupials, platypuses, spiny anteaters, or placental mammals”（有袋动物、鸭嘴兽、针鼹和胎盘哺乳动物）是为了说明哺乳动物的共同特征，即喂养幼崽是所有哺乳动物的定义性特征。对应C选项。 选项分析： A 文章没有详细对比不同类型哺乳动物（如有袋动物、鸭嘴兽、针鼹和胎盘哺乳动物）的喂养习惯的具体差异，而是强调它们共同的特征——喂养幼崽。 B 文章没有讨论哺乳动物如何被定义的历史或过程，而是直接指出喂养幼崽是哺乳动物的定义性特征（“the defining feature of a mammal”）。 D 虽然文章提到喂养幼崽是哺乳动物育儿行为中“nonelective”（不可选择的）部分，但列举这些动物并不是为了解释这一特征为何不可选择，而是为了说明这一特征在所有哺乳动物中的普遍存在。

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the passage about the practice of animal parents feeding their young?

options.B: It is unrelated to the size of the young.
options.C: It is dangerous for the parents.
options.D: It is most common among mammals.

questions.analysis: 题型：推理题 原文分析：文章第一段强调喂养幼崽是哺乳动物的定义性特征（“the defining feature of a mammal”），并指出这是所有哺乳动物（有袋动物、鸭嘴兽、针鼹和胎盘哺乳动物）的共同点。相比之下，文章提到大多数鱼类、爬行动物（如鳄鱼）和昆虫不直接喂养幼崽，而是通过其他方式（如保护或提供食物储备）照顾后代。因此，喂养幼崽的行为在哺乳动物中最常见，D选项符合文章内容。 选项分析： A选项。文章指出，“Most egg-guarding fish do not [feed their young], for the simple reason that their young are so much smaller than the parents and eat food that is also much smaller than the food eaten by adults.” 这表明大多数护卵的鱼类不喂养幼崽，但并未说喂养行为在鱼类中完全不存在（“most”暗示可能有例外）。因此，A选项过于绝对。 B选项，文章明确提到鱼类不喂养幼崽的原因是幼崽体型小，吃的食物也比成鱼吃的食物小得多（“their young are so much smaller than the parents and eat food that is also much smaller”）。这表明喂养行为与幼崽的体型有关，因此B选项不正确。 C选项，文章完全没有提到喂养幼崽对父母动物有任何危险。

questions.stem: The word “provisioning” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 选项分析：provision做动词表示“为…提供必需品”的意思，等于supply。 B选项是“准备”的意思。C选项是“构建”的意思。D选项是“扩张”的意思。

questions.stem: According to the passage, how do some insects make sure their young have food?

options.A: By storing food near their young.
options.B: By locating their nests or cells near spiders and caterpillars.
options.C: By searching for food some distance from their nest.
options.D: By gathering food from a nearby water source.

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文分析：文章在第二段提到，“Few insects feed their young after hatching, but some make other arrangement, provisioning their cells and nests with caterpillars and spiders that they have paralyzed with their venom and stored in a state of suspended animation so that their larvae might have a supply of fresh food when they hatch.” 这明确指出一些昆虫通过在巢或细胞中储存被麻痹的毛虫和蜘蛛来为幼崽提供食物，A选项准确描述了这一行为。 选项分析： B 文章没有提到昆虫通过将巢建在蜘蛛和毛虫附近来确保幼崽有食物。相反，文章描述的是昆虫主动捕获蜘蛛和毛虫，用毒液麻痹它们并储存在巢中，而不是依赖自然分布的食物来源。因此，B选项不符合文章内容。 C 文章没有提到昆虫在远离巢的地方寻找食物来为幼崽提供食物。 D 文章完全没有提到昆虫从水源收集食物。
